name: Sai (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sai village emblem in blue: a stylised bird with outstretched wings above a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Sai, a village in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 14 May 1971; the emblem dates from 18 July 1972.

features.role: Sai village emblem — a stylised bird with outstretched wings above a disc
